Study results.

Cost versus unit fill

    Policy comparison

    Base cost assumptions. Service-floor status refers to the full CA_1 cohort on validation.

    ForecastRuleUnit fillLost unitsMean stockCostValidated

    How it works.

    Follow the forecast from expected demand to a purchase recommendation.

    Review inventory

    Receipts due today become available first. The inventory position adds available stock and firm receipts still due later.

    Position = available + still on order

    Choose an order

    A daily review uses a target covering the lead time plus one day. The suggested order fills the gap in whole units.

    Order = round up max(0, target − position)

    Reveal recorded sales

    Orders arrive after the lead time. Any recorded units above available stock count as lost in the replay. They do not carry over.

    Unit fill = filled units ÷ recorded units

    Compare the study

    The results use 3,049 CA_1 items. Policy settings were selected before April. Lower simulated cost matters alongside achieved service. A higher forecast quantile does not promise the same fill rate.

    Open study results
    Scope. M5 provides recorded sales, calendar information and listed prices. Stock, lost demand and costs in this demo come from a simulation. The worked replay uses three teaching items. Manual decisions change your simulated inventory. The historical sales path is fixed.
